title: Fix TypeSpec LRO operations: remove @extension, use @useFinalStateVia
intent: Make six ARM action operations visible as LROs to both OpenAPI and SDK generators by replacing OpenAPI-only extensions with TypeSpec LRO metadata.
transformationChain: Retain 202, Location, Retry-After, polling, and final-result wire behavior.
restRepresentation: The six POST operations remain 202 ARM LROs using Location and Retry-After with final-state-via location; the change fixes SDK LRO recognition without changing their REST signatures.

artifactEvidence.autorest: base/head OpenAPI both retain x-ms-long-running-operation and final-state-via location
artifactEvidence.tcgc: the head uses TypeSpec LRO metadata understood by TCGC instead of an OpenAPI-only extension

downstreamFindings.title: Generated SDK methods change from synchronous to long-running
downstreamFindings.summary: The wire contract is unchanged, but SDKs now expose poller/LRO return types and asynchronous completion semantics.
evidence: @useFinalStateVia is visible to both AutoRest and TCGC while @extension was OpenAPI-only.

evidence: AutoRest removes enum values and response schemas from a stable API version.
